ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious LSASS Access Via MalSecLogon
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious access to LSASS handle via a call trace to "seclogon.dll" with a suspicious access right. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, SourceImage, GrantedAccess, CallTrace

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x14c0" AND CallTrace = RGX(".*seclogon\\\.dll.*"))
